output.scope_note: The paper is a DFT study of α-LixBN2 cathodes, but it reports a previously measured Li-ion conductivity of α-Li3BN2 (3 mS/cm), so it contains at least one conductivity value for a solid Li-ion conductor.

records.evidence_quote: α-Li3 BN2 is also known as a good Li-ion conductor with experimentally observed 3 mS/cm
records.notes: Value is from earlier experimental work (refs 16, 20, 21, measured nearly 30 years ago), not measured in this paper. Temperature 400 K is taken from the Results section sentence 'measured at T = 400 K temperature'. Activation energy given as 78 kJ/mol (≈0.8 eV) in the abstract. The paper also lists 6 mS/cm values for the beta and monoclinic Li3BN2 phases, which were not recorded because the mapping of values to phases is not cleanly quotable.
